info.name: local_vcostaedu: VCOSTAEDU service for reviewers
info.description: Requests for the web service "VCOSTAEDU" (short name `local_vcostaedu`) created by the Moodle plugin local_vcostaedu. Fill in two collection variables: `baseurl`, the Moodle address without a slash at the end, and `token`, the key shown on *Site administration > Plugins > Local plugins > VCOSTAEDU > Connect to VCOSTAEDU*. Then run the folders in order, or the whole collection with the collection runner. Every request is a POST to the Moodle REST server with a JSON answer, and the key travels in the body. Guide: extra/postman/README.md.

exec: // The two values the reviewer fills in: the Moodle address and the key of the connect page.
throw new Error('Fill in the collection variable "baseurl" (the Moodle address, without a slash at the end).');
throw new Error('Remove the slash at the end of "baseurl".');
throw new Error('Fill in the collection variable "token" (the key shown on the page Connect to VCOSTAEDU).');

item.name: 4. Enrolment changes
item.description: Changes to the enrolment of the student created in folder 2: a second role, suspension, reactivation, unenrolment and enrolment with another role. Through the service, a role is changed by enrolling again with the new role (Moodle adds it), and a role is removed only by unenrolling. The service has no group functions, so there is no group request. Each change is followed by a request that checks it. Run folder 2 first.
